description: This file provides an interface for the CVXOPT optimization library to interact with the MOSEK 8 solver, including functions for linear programming, second-order cone programming, quadratic programming, and mixed-integer linear programming. It defines functions for solving various convex optimization problems and handles external dependencies on the 'mosek' library and 'cvxopt' matrices.

methods.name: streamprinter
methods.description: A helper function to output text to stdout and flush the buffer.

methods.name: lp
methods.description: Solves a pair of primal and dual linear programs using MOSEK 8.

methods.name: conelp
methods.description: Solves a pair of primal and dual second-order cone programs using MOSEK 8.

methods.name: socp
methods.description: Solves a pair of primal and dual second-order cone programs with multiple cones.

methods.name: qp
methods.description: Solves a quadratic programming problem with quadratic and linear terms.

methods.name: ilp
methods.description: Solves a mixed-integer linear programming problem, with integer constraints on specified variables.
